title: Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Processing in Large Language Models: A Cognitive Benchmarking Framework Integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on the cultural knowledge of the Taiwanese Hakka ethnic group, including language, architecture, culinary practices, festivals, and social customs.
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion, as its focus is on cultural knowledge of the Hakka ethnic group.
